8. Executed 500-attempt service model

The campaign uses 250 face exchanges followed by 250 strut exchanges, with a paid two-hour unloaded family change.

The controller receives observations and command history. Challenge labels are confined to the simulated plant and experiment scheduler.

There are five examples of each of seven challenge categories:

False apparent engagement.
Friction-held apparent seating.
Persistent isolation jam.
Partly open jam.
Seized final foot.
Seized head-cage release.
Power outage.

Additional admitted outages bring the total one-hour outage count to 16.

Result	Executed model
Attempts retained	500
Conditional controller completions	500
Conditional incomplete attempts	0
Physical exchanges / qualified physical exchanges	0 / 0
Unannounced challenges	35
Maximum sampled quasistatic translation	0.357 mm
Maximum sampled rotation	0.179°
Maximum sampled pad force	1.936 kN
Member-neck cuts	15
Foot-neck cuts	5
Keeper-ear cuts	0
Rejected replacement kits	10
One-hour outages	16
Modeled elapsed equipment time	160.766 h
Local stage electricity	33.612 kWh

All 500 final model states have the replacement carrying the imposed wrench, no retained temporary tools/fragments, and the circulating inventory restored.

That is a state and accounting result under the model premises. It is not evidence that unrepresented geometry fits or that the failed uncertainty and transient-strength screens have been overcome.
